  PROBLEM: `_TEMPLATE_USES_LINE_RE` and `_TEMPLATE_PINNED_ACTION_RE` only recognise the `owner/repo@<hex40>` form for SHA-pinning, so a pinned Docker container action (`uses: docker://ghcr.io/owner/image@sha256:<64hex>`) would be flagged as unpinned.
  WHY: Digest pinning is an equivalent security guarantee, but no current template uses Docker container actions, so this is a forward-compat gap only. Suggested fix: extend `_TEMPLATE_PINNED_ACTION_RE` with `(?:docker://[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})` (about 1 line).
